lead: Captured aviation feed data for October 2025 through October 2026 highlights competitive activity across EFB, flight planning, and crew systems. Vendor announcements feature major airline agreements and platform expansions, with distinct adoption patterns across carriers.

insights.title: IFS secures multiple EFB customer wins
insights.finding: IFS captured customer wins for its IFS EFBOne platform with fastjet, MY FREIGHTER (Centrum Air), and TUS Airways.
insights.aviation_context: fastjet is an African low-cost carrier (LCC); MY FREIGHTER / Centrum Air is classified as an LCC; TUS Airways is classified as a hybrid/leisure carrier.
insights.caveat: Captured signal texts report selection and deployment announcements without independent verification of fleet-wide operational integration.

insights.title: Aviobook wins Royal Air Maroc EFB agreement
insights.finding: Thales subsidiary Aviobook signed a five-year agreement with Royal Air Maroc to supply the AvioBook Flight EFB platform.
insights.aviation_context: Royal Air Maroc operates as a full-service international carrier.
insights.caveat: Contract duration and platform scope are cited from vendor-related LinkedIn captures.

insights.title: Navblue expands TransNusa collaboration
insights.finding: TransNusa expanded its agreement with Navblue to adopt Skywise Core X2 and Skywise Fleet Performance+.
insights.aviation_context: TransNusa operates regional and domestic low-cost/hybrid services in Indonesia.
insights.caveat: Terms of the expansion agreement are based on vendor press releases.

insights.title: Lufthansa Systems deploys Lido solutions to Kenya Airways and Viva
insights.finding: Lufthansa Systems implemented Lido Flight 4D for Kenya Airways and deployed Lido mPilot for Viva.
insights.aviation_context: Kenya Airways is a full-service flag carrier.
insights.caveat: Implementation status relies on vendor LinkedIn disclosures.

insights.title: LCC EFB adoption activity captured across vendors
insights.finding: LCC and hybrid airline adoption signals for EFB platforms are distributed across vendors including IFS (fastjet, MY FREIGHTER) and Jeppesen (Corendon Airlines).
insights.aviation_context: fastjet and MY FREIGHTER (Centrum Air) are classified as LCCs; Corendon Airlines operates in the leisure/LCC segment.
insights.caveat: Evidence reflects captured feed mentions and does not represent exhaustive market share data.
